title: Optimizing AI Models for Inference
description: How to make trained AI models smaller, faster and cheaper to run: quantization, pruning, distillation, batching, compilers and runtimes, LLM tricks like the KV cache and speculative decoding, plus serving cost and how to verify nothing broke. Built for developers new to ML. Builds on this library's mlops course for the wider production lifecycle (registries, pipelines, monitoring) — see it for that foundation.

changelog.notes: Initial release — 31 decks, each pack with a preview card teaching the concept before its graded main card and practice cards, including scenario questions and packs on modern LLM serving topics.
